description: One undo on the feature-bar stack (sketch session, assembly joints, or active part script) and run when the part script changes. An assembly undo reverts one assembly action, so a joint undo leaves a part move that joint does not name. A part step returns the refreshed status, bodyCount included. Takes return: "status" | "summary" | "full" (MCP default "status": status.script is omitted; "summary" adds status.features; "full" echoes the script).

return.description: How much of status to return: "status" drops status.script, "summary" drops it and adds status.features (the feature strip), "full" keeps the whole script. Over MCP the default is "status"; in the page it is "full". Read the script with get_script.

name: undo
